scripts.predev: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @ufmg/server" "npm run dev -w @ufmg/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config && npm run build -w @ufmg/server && npm run build -w @ufmg/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config && npm run build -w @ufmg/web
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config
scripts.pretest:run: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @ufmg/shared && npm run build -w @ufmg/config
